item.subject: science
item.stem: In her school science class in Pune, Meera observes an Amoeba (a single cell) under the microscope, while her classmate Arjun sketches a neem plant (made of many cells). Which of the following statements about how living organisms are built from cells is correct: () A. Only large organisms like the neem plant are made of cells, while tiny organisms like Amoeba are not made of cells; B. All living organisms are made of cells, whether they have one cell like Amoeba or many cells like the neem plant; C. Only organisms with many cells can carry out life processes, so a single cell cannot be a complete organism; D. Cells are found only in plants and animals, and not in microorganisms

options.A: Only large organisms like the neem plant are made of cells, while tiny organisms like Amoeba are not made of cells
options.B: All living organisms are made of cells, whether they have one cell like Amoeba or many cells like the neem plant
options.C: Only organisms with many cells can carry out life processes, so a single cell cannot be a complete organism
options.D: Cells are found only in plants and animals, and not in microorganisms
